subject: Which fabric for a house with two dogs?
body: Hi! I'm about to order the Harlow 3-seater and I see three fabric grades at checkout. We have two dogs and a four-year-old, and I can't tell which one actually holds up. Which should I pick? Thanks!

result.draft:
Thank you for reaching out to Sable & Wren!

Great question — and with two dogs and a four-year-old in the mix, the answer is pretty clear: Performance Weave is the one we recommend for your household. It is our stain- and scratch-resistant fabric grade, and it is exactly what we had in mind when we designed it — pets and small children are the use case it was built for.

A quick word on the other two grades so you have the full picture. Everyday Weave is our standard cotton-linen blend — lovely, but it will show wear faster in a high-activity home. Full-Grain Leather wipes clean easily and develops a beautiful patina over time, but it is not scratch-proof, so dogs can mark it.

Performance Weave is available on the Harlow II (our 2026 collection), so that is the version to look at when you are ready to order. If you would like to feel the fabric before committing, we are happy to send swatch cards of all three grades at no charge — just reply with your mailing address and we will get them out to you.

Let us know if you have any other questions before you order!

subject: Fabric + doorway + a quick call?
body: Three quick things: which fabric grade should I pick if we have a golden retriever? Will the Harlow 3-seater fit through a 30-inch doorway? And can we set up a quick call this week to walk me through the room-of-choice delivery options?

result.draft:
Thank you for reaching out to Sable & Wren, Jordan!

Happy to help with all three — let me take them in turn.

For a household with a golden retriever, we would steer you toward Performance Weave. It is our stain- and scratch-resistant fabric grade, and it is exactly what we recommend for homes with pets. Everyday Weave is a lovely cotton-linen blend but it will show wear from claws and dander more readily, and Full-Grain Leather wipes clean beautifully but is not scratch-proof, so a dog with active paws can mark it over time. Performance Weave is the clear choice here. If you would like to feel the difference before committing, we ship swatch cards of all three fabric grades free of charge — just say the word and we will get a set out to you.

On the doorway question: yes, the Harlow 3-seater will clear a 30-inch doorway. The legs unscrew for delivery, and with the legs off the frame sits at 29 inches deep, so it passes through a 30-inch opening with just an inch to spare. Worth measuring the full path — hallways, any turns — but the doorway itself should not be a problem.

On setting up a call: we are a small team running support through this inbox, and we do not have a phone or scheduling line to offer. That said, I am very happy to walk you through the room-of-choice delivery options right here over email — it is genuinely the fastest way to get you accurate answers, and I can be thorough. Just let me know what questions you have and I will get back to you quickly.

TO BE CONFIRMED
